messages:
noah: Small docs bug: the /v1/generate API reference still documents `max_tokens` as the parameter for limiting new output, but the runtime now expects `max_new_tokens` for parity with other platforms. This caused a customer report where responses were being cut off because client libraries set max_tokens in the wrong place.

noah: Docs example currently:```json
{
  "model": "redwood-clarity-1",
  "prompt": "Summarize: ...",
  "max_tokens": 150
}
```

noah: Actual expected request body:```json
{
  "model": "redwood-clarity-1",
  "prompt": "Summarize: ...",
  "max_new_tokens": 150
}
```

emma: Good catch. We intentionally introduced `max_new_tokens` to avoid ambiguity with token counting in hybrid sampling, but forgot to update a few reference pages and SDK snippets. Can you open a PR to update the API reference, quickstart, and the Python/Node examples? Also add a migration note.

noah: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/12789. I updated docs and added a short migration callout: "Note: use max_new_tokens to limit newly generated tokens; max_tokens is deprecated for generation endpoints."

cli-bot: lint/docs-check failed: example tests expect numeric literal without trailing comments. (file: api/generate.md line 88)

noah: Fixing the snippet formatting and removing inline comments. Also adding a compatibility snippet for SDKs showing both fields:```python
# defensive access for older clients
params = {
  "model": "redwood-clarity-1",
  "prompt": prompt
}
# prefer the explicit new param
params["max_new_tokens"] = 150
# maintain backwards-compat for callers still using max_tokens
if user_provided_max_tokens is not None:
  params["max_new_tokens"] = user_provided_max_tokens
resp = client.generate(params)
```

emma: Can we add a tiny unit test in docs/spec that asserts example bodies include either "max_new_tokens" or a migration note? That would prevent re-introducing the old key.

qa: I'll add a quick regression test in the docs test harness to grep examples for the new key. Also we'll add an integration test to the SDK examples suite that sends both keys and verifies the server prefers max_new_tokens.

noah: CI passed after fixing the snippet. @emma can you review and approve? After merge, please ask #support to notify any customers who embedded the GET curl or script with the old param.

emma: Reviewing now. LGTY with one tiny wording tweak in the migration note to mention compatibility window. I'll approve after that. :white_check_mark:

staging-bot: Deployed docs/generate-max-new-tokens-update to staging at 1915678987 (sha: c3f9a2b). Preview: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/api/generate#params

noah: Staging looks good. Examples render and new migration note shows. Closing after merge + support notification. :rocket:
